lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to say that anyone slaughtering an ox, lamb, or goat must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
The Israelites must bring their sacrifices from the open fields to the priest, who splatters the blood on the altar.
God says the Israelites must no longer offer their sacrifices to Molech, and this is a permanent statute.
God forbids Israelites and foreigners to eat blood because the life of the flesh is in the blood, given to make atonement on their doorposts.
Anyone who eats an animal found dead or mauled must wash his clothes and bathe, or he will bear his iniquity.
